system.description:
This skill may only be used on willing targets. Select one from [Flame] [Cold] [Shock] [Holy] [Blight] [Spirit]. The target deals damage of the chosen tag.

(Effect): While this [Harmony] is in effect, increase your [Hate] by +1 during the Cleanup Process of every round.

A support song that summons magical powers of various attributes with a melody reminiscent of a foreign land and grants that power to attacks.
